provenance.note: Hand-authored synthetic multi-way decision tasks for the Jev typed-decision spike. Every scenario, name, company, and date below is invented. This file is egress-eligible (R9) precisely because it contains no owner or user content — never add real material here. Real recorded navigation traces belong in a different path, never this egress-audited file (KTD10, R8).
